name: wasm-canonical-docker
command: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --target dependencies -f Dockerfile.reproducible (multi-chain-wallet-tools 76cce41, clean) ; docker run --network none node tooling/build-recovery-sskr-wasm.mjs ; compare generated files with vendor/sskr/generated
note: exitCode 1 for the host rebuild records the byte difference, not a tool failure; see log
